profile.headline: Data Engineer | Big Data and Cloud Technologies | US Citizen
profile.summary:
Experience in Exporting Data from Various RDBMS and file based sources to Big Query in Google Cloud Platform
Designed and implemented highly efficient data processing pipelines using Google Cloud Dataflow, significantly enhancing data transformation and aggregation workflows
Leveraged Google Cloud Dataflow’s autoscaling capabilities to dynamically adapt resource allocation, ensuring optimal scalability and performance under varying loads
Integrated Google Dataflow solutions with other GCP services like BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and GCS, creating a cohesive data ecosystem and driving company-wide data initiatives
Worked closely with data scientists and analytics teams to set up and manage Google Dataproc environments that aligned with specific project needs, promoting cross-functional collaboration and agile response to business demands
Hands on experience to migrate Hadoop data to GCP 
Development and Design experience in Data warehousing , ETL, Big Data /Hadoop/HDFS in Hadoop ecosystem such as Hive, Pig, Sqoop 
Experience in Spark using Scala and Python
Experience using automation tools like Jenkins, Ansible and Git
Hands on experience in implementing business logic and optimizing the query using Hive SQL 
Experience of Importing data using sqoop into HDFS from various Relational Database Systems
Experience with Unix/Linux Shell Scripting
Experience with Agile development methodology
